svg.text: CONTROL VALVE, FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
SERVICE CODES: P PROCESS HYDROCARBON · FO FUEL OIL
HF HEATING FLUID · LS LP STEAM · DR DRAIN
ANY TRIP: CLOSE XV-301 & XV-302, OPEN XV-303 BLEED,
RESET ONLY FROM BMS AFTER 300 s PURGE; LIGHT-OFF
AT LOW FIRE (TIC-030 MAN 10-20 %), 10 s TRIAL.
1. DESIGN BASIS: NATURAL DRAFT FIRED HEATER VER 1 OTS MODEL, DESIGN CASE. PRESSURES kPa g, DRAFT mmH₂O.
FEED 6.8 L/s = 19 584 kg/h (0.80 kg/L): 40 → 180 (E-100) → 233 (CROSSOVER) → 350 °C; PUMP DISCH. ≈ 1030, OUTLET ≈ 545.
FUEL 243 kg/h, LHV 42 MJ/kg: FIRED 2.84 MW, ABSORBED 2.31 MW (81.5 %). AIR 3 892 kg/h (11 % EXCESS).
FLUE GAS 4 380 kg/h AT 400 °C (INCL. ≈ 245 kg/h TRAMP AIR). DRAFT: ARCH -2.5, FLOOR -6.0, WINDBOX 5.25.
2. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY FROM VELOCITY (LIQUID 1.5-2.5 m/s, AIR DUCT 10 m/s) - TBC BY HYDRAULIC CALCULATION.
3. PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN). PUMP CASING VENTS/DRAINS TYP., NOT SHOWN.
4. XV-301 / XV-302 / XV-303 FORM A DOUBLE BLOCK AND BLEED, OPERATED BY SIS-100 (BMS); SIGNALS NOT SHOWN.
5. FV-010 FAILS OPEN SO THE COIL KEEPS FLOW ON AIR OR SIGNAL FAILURE; FV-300 FAILS CLOSED; FV-200 & HV-400 FAIL OPEN.
6. RADIANT AND CONVECTION COILS SHOWN SCHEMATICALLY; TUBE COUNT AND PASSES PER DESIGN TAB (SINGLE PASS).
7. FT-008 SERVES FIC-003, FIAL-008 AND FSLL-008 (HAZOP GAP: ADD FT-008B FOR THE TRIP - HOLD).
8. TIC-030 MOVES FUEL ONLY. REV A: FIC-005 ON OWN SET POINT. REV B OPTION: FY-005 AIR/FUEL RATIO ON FI-001 + AIC-027 O₂ TRIM.
9. PSV-101 PROTECTS E-100 FEED SIDE (BLOCKED-IN WITH HOT FLUID, TUBE RUPTURE). SET PRESSURE AND SIZE TBC.
10. PI-019 = FUEL HEADER (≈ 1940 kPa g). PT-020 = GUN PRESSURE (≈ 600 kPa g), DOWNSTREAM OF FV-300.
11. BS-005 UV FLAME SCANNER ON THE BURNER; LIGHT-OFF AND PURGE PER BMS SEQUENCE (LEGEND PANEL).
12. HV-221 SNUFFING STEAM, NORMALLY CLOSED; OPEN ONLY FOR A FIREBOX FIRE. EXPLOSION DOOR ON RADIANT WALL.
13. LOW-POINT DRAIN ON 3"-P-105 AND HIGH-POINT VENT AT COIL INLET FOR HYDROTEST AND DECOKING.
14. ALARM SET POINTS: SEE WORKBOOK (ALARM TABLE); TRIP SET POINTS: INTERLOCK SCHEDULE.
